description: Looped baselines run past their trained depth (E2) and their q-head halting (E4)
puzzles: Sudoku-Extreme: FRM 1,000 test puzzles (full-all rows 10,000-10,999); Maze-Unique: all 1,000 test mazes

definitions.rel_change: ||z_t - z_(t-1)|| / ||z_(t-1)|| per puzzle; median and 90th percentile over puzzles
definitions.answer_change_fraction: fraction of puzzles whose decoded answer at t differs from t - 1
definitions.wrong_halt_rate: puzzles halted by the q-head at an incorrect board / puzzles halted by the q-head
definitions.converged: median rel_change at 8 x trained depth < 1e-3 or <= 1/10 of its value at the trained depth

cram_comparison: CRAM energy stopping test: 0 test puzzles stopped at an incorrect board on either benchmark
